about: One conformance corpus for kitlib proc (ompkit-5m6ej, KL09), read by tests/cli/kitlib-proc.test.ts (src/kitlib/proc.ts) and tests/scripts/kitlib_proc_test.py (scripts/kitlib_proc.py). subject: live (a running child of the test), dead (a child that exited and was reaped), zombie (a child that exited and is deliberately not reaped until teardown), unreadable (any pid; the ps seam reports a timeout). recorded: observed (the start incarnation() read while the subject ran, captured before it died), wrong (WRONG_START), any (WRONG_START; the seam decides). expect: state and is_dead. negatives: a planted detector disabled through the seam must flip case `flips` away from its expected state and failing it, while case `control` still passes with the same detector disabled. malformed: probe inputs refused with a TypeError; malformed_pids: incarnation() pids refused.
